system.description:
Will Amp

Your Miraigan grants you the following benefits

Prophetic Vision. You cannot be surprised and hostile creatures cannot gain advantage on attacks against you for being unseen or Hidden.

Déjà vu. Once per turn, when a hostile creature casts a Jutsu while within 60 feet of you, you can spend 1 Foresight, to make a Read the Enemy or Identify Jutsu check at No reaction or action cost.

Eyes of the Wolf. Your foresight extends into social and environmental situations. You gain a rank of Mastery to Insight checks and checks to Identify Jutsu and Read the Enemy.
system.summary: You can't be surprised, and being unseen gives foes no advantage on you. Free Read the Enemy or Identify, and Mastery on Insight, Identify and Read the Enemy.

rules.text: At initiative it lasts until combat ends; as a Bonus action, 10 minutes, then 10 minutes of non-use.
Eyes of the Wolf: the Mastery on Identify Jutsu and Read the Enemy is applied at the table (Insight is automatic).
